design_intent: Realistic adult fantasy broom-sport athletes, inspired by Hogwarts-style clothing
appearance_requirements: Human face, eyes, ears, hair and hands with anatomically plausible adult proportions
Preserve natural skin and eye materials separately from team clothing
Forest Service mint with restrained phthalo influence and copper with a small canary-yellow influence
Flight clothing, trousers, boots and glove details; no visible mannequin or robot panels
Seated broom pose with correct grips and foot positions
Verify face, hair, clothing intersections and silhouette at gameplay distances

team_palette.apply_only_to: Garment materials; never to skin, face, eyes or hair

main_game_integration_requires: Correct first-person hiding and remote player appearance
Unchanged collision, gameplay authority and equipment behavior
Packaged validation and performance review with the full roster

native_hogwarts: Separate native appearance definitions and compatible native cosmetics; do not copy UE5 MetaHuman assets into Creator Kit
